title: Greywatch - Attempting to polish the game
author: Funny-Sprinkles-4518
selftext:
I've been working on this game for maybe a month and a half now. I've been trying to use Opus 5 and 5.5 to polish it lately. I've had it do a lot of work on lighting and shadows, water, grass, sounds, and model detail.

I asked for more detail in some of the building models, and then when I liked the level it was giving me I had it create a skill with ballpark levels on different types of structures. Not all of them are done yet. The first map in the video has gotten the most work so far.

With the environment (water, grass, lighting, etc.) I just described what I wanted and had it try until I liked the way it looked. All of the sounds were generated with Adobe Firefly.

There's still a lot that needs polishing, but I think it's been making progress and wanted to share. The game is open source (https://github.com/greywatch-game/greywatch) if anyone is interested in that.
